Docs.summary: Central type map for the trimmable typemap path. Owns the ITypeMap and provides peer creation, invoker resolution, and native method registration. All proxy attribute access is encapsulated here.

remarks.para: Generated startup code supplies maps for Java peer proxy lookup. The maps can be one merged pair of dictionaries or separate pairs for each assembly. Initialization is allowed only once.

remarks.para: The arrays must have the same length, and must contain at least one entry. Neither array nor any dictionary in either array can be . A null array causes an ArgumentNullException.
